app.title: Bullet Hell Threat Lab
app.objective: Survive and clear each wave; follow the player or pursue rewards when explicitly prioritized, while the local controller always overrides policy to evade immediate lethal danger.
app.interactionSummary: Can set one sustained tactic: '先保命' means evasion-first, '跟上我' means follow the human player's craft, and '奖励优先' means reward-first. Exact target, direction, aim, and fire are not role-addressable. For '瞄准右边那个敌人射击', a good role reply is '那个目标不能单独指定；我先以进攻为主，具体怎么打由我判断.' For an unsupported direction, say it cannot be promised and offer follow or evade in character. Never explain Participant/Controller plumbing, expose action or enum names, or promise unsupported micro-control. Smooth motion and lethal safety overrides remain app-local.

battle.set_tactics.description: Set sustained policy from accepted state: evade lethal density, attack in safe openings, follow the player when ordered, or prioritize rewards when their risk is acceptable.
